title: sc-security-dossier manifest
description: Which security domains this repository's dossier covers, and what surface its canvas may be published to. The surface is required: the dossier is the most complete attack plan the toolkit can generate about a system, and publishing it without a declared surface is an undeclared outward send.

surface.description: The sc-nda-check surface the canvas is cleared for. Required. An undeclared surface is treated as public, the most restrictive, and the canvas is withheld until the check passes.

canvas.description: Local path the canvas HTML is written to before any publish. The local file is always written; publishing is gated.

domains.description: Domains to cover, each naming its owning tool. Absent means every applicable domain. A domain omitted here is unrun, and unrun is reported as unrun, never as passing.

posture_source.description: Where posture is resolved from. Defaults to .claude/security-audit.yaml, so a repository declares its posture once.

posture_baseline.description: Path to the locked infrastructure posture baseline. Without one the sc-security-posture domain has nothing to detect a weakening from and is reported N-A rather than invented.

correlation.description: Compound-risk correlation settings. Correlation is the only place the dossier raises a severity, and it must show the chain that justifies it.
